verdict: of the 13 boundary sites, exactly one FDE fills the element per-field: 0x36a1330, on caller_b2's site, storing all eight join-callee fields on its stack (+0x40 = 0, +0x58 = 10^14, +0x60 = 0, +0x78 = 10^14, +0x80/+0x88/+0x90/+0x98 copied from its own incoming element argument at +0x8..+0x28).  Six sites pass an incoming argument unchanged (the three join-consumer clones' 5th-argument array cursor; three adapters' 3rd/4th/1st arguments), and six stage a wholesale copy (the lookup helper's result record in 0x2c62590; the r12 record in 0x2c64870 and 0x55e3770, two sites each; the [rsp+0x410] record in 0x55defd0).  The first per-field writer above the remaining sites is whoever produces those incoming arrays, argument structs and records.
